title: R' Yehudah bar Bizna

paragraphs: A homily of his survives in [Nedarim 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.32a.3): when Moses our teacher neglected circumcision, Af and Chema—Anger and Wrath—came and swallowed him, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rabbi Yehudah bar Bizna as the speaker. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1701&lang=en) cites the same folio.
Af and Chema are personified anger and wrath. Hyman breaks off his quotation before the account of Tzipporah.
